fact: Decree 2011/PR/2026 of 1 June 2026 appoints a director (replacing a predecessor) and a deputy director of ANSICE's Direction du contrôle et de la protection des données personnelles; the document does not say a law names ANSICE as the authority.
The Cabinet Thomas Dingamgoto analysis says Loi n°007/PR/2015 gives ANSICE the formalities for data transfers, while the agency's operational effectiveness is not documented.
ACTPOL says Chad entrusted its 2015 data protection law to ANSICE, which a 2022 assessment found was not independently structured.
